topic: Progesterone's calming effect — during luteal phase
caption: Did you know progesterone can calm your mind and body? 🙏 During the luteal phase, this hormone helps reduce anxiety and stress. 💆‍♀️ Here are the science-backed facts: Progesterone increases GABA, a neurotransmitter that calms the brain. 🧠 It also supports the growth of new neurons, improving mood. 🌱 Additionally, progesterone helps regulate sleep patterns, ensuring a restful night's sleep. 😴 Save this so you don't lose it.
